topic: An 82-year-old Walmart cashier and widower retires after a pest-control owner's TikTok raises $150,000; why he was still working
title: He Was 82 and Still Working at Walmart. Nobody Knew Why #truestory
description:
#truestory #kindness #veteran

"How could I get so lucky?"

Butch was 82, a Navy vet, still working 8 to 9-hour shifts at a Walmart register. A guy buying batteries asked his TikTok followers one question. What nobody in that line knew was why Butch was still working at all.

#mayorofmainst #truestory #kindness

Source: NPR, WJLA, Cumberland Times-News (Jan 2023)

Retold with AI voice & visuals
fact_notes: NPR 2023-01-13 (Jaclyn Diaz): last month (Dec 2022) Rory McCarty at his local Walmart near Cumberland, Md., ran in for batteries, stuck in line; quote 'I kind of looked up and I seen this little, older guy there at the register, just grinding... Look at this guy. He's got to be in his 80s.'; Warren 'Butch' Marion, 82, part time 16 years (WJLA: 40-hour weeks, sometimes more); decades at General Motors and Honeywell, 10-year stint in U.S. Navy; 'I've been working since I've been 11 years old'; debt; McCarty's TikTok for pest control company Bug Boys, more than 250,000 followers (WJLA 300K, Scripps 279K); 42-second video; caption '82yr old Butch still putting in work... We ought to do that for Butch. Who would donate?'; days later returned to Walmart to tell him; with his approval created GoFundMe; 'In two days. It raised over $100,000'; almost $150,000 at writing; put in two weeks notice; 'We're like peas and carrots'; 'Out of all the people. I was the one that was chosen... it's a beautiful, beautiful experience'. WJLA/TND 2023-01-09: Navy veteran and widower; GoFundMe text 'Working 8 to 9 hour shifts'; check handed with balloons and applause, first word 'wow'; Cumberland Times News: pay off his house, travel to Florida to see his kids; 'All I can tell you is the good Lord has blessed me for what I did in my younger years'. Scripps/FOX13 (Simplemost): retired from GM to help care for his ex-wife and her first husband until they died; then cared for his wife through breast cancer; she died 2005, he returned to work to make ends meet; check for more than $108,000, 'How could I get so lucky?'; 'I'll be able to travel to Florida whenever I feel like going and see my kids. I'm very, very blessed.'; total more than $152,000. Paraphrased: Rory's TikTok line ('We ought to help Butch retire'). Assumed (not reported): looks/clothes, Rory's age, home office/diner/porch/Florida scenes drawn as illustrations of what was reported, Navy photo era.
